g.text: ocks the feature without losing your place.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/evals.md:558:* **Overview tab** — every run with its summary metrics, plus a Suite Health chart whose
bars link to individual run rows. Click in for the iteration-level breakdown. The table shows **Date** first, then **Run**, with s
eparate **Client**, **Model**, **Platform**, **Commit**, **Rate**, **Latency**, **Tokens**, and **Calls** columns. The Client colu
mn counts unique clients; when there are more than two, a **+N** badge appears — hover it to see all clients in a tooltip.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/evals.md:578:* **Stamped.** The platform decides a run's `source` itself, and a caller cannot
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/evals.md:588:strength of it. Alongside both, the platform records the credential the request
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/evals.md:595:When two or more host configurations are attached to a suite, a **By case / By host** tog
gle appears. **By host** shows a matrix — one column per host, one row per case. Each cell shows pass/fail dots, pass rate, median
latency, and token usage. A host detached after runs were recorded stays visible, labelled **historical**.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs/evals.md:599:Every iteration carries the MCPJam-billed cost of the model work it did,
